scope: Bounded rank-8 VACE RGB-alpha-contact adapter training execution
summary: Physical A800 GPU 5 completed all 96 planned optimization steps and produced four reproducible checkpoints; this establishes training execution only, not general hand/contact quality.
evidence: GPU preflight selected physical A800 GPU 5 with 72,576 MiB free and recorded CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES.
Effective settings are rank 8, learning rate 2e-5, four epochs, dataset repeat 2, 448x256x17, and seed 20260812.
Training returned code 0 after approximately 524.18 seconds.
lessons: A semantically explicit RGB-alpha-contact curriculum is trainable on the pinned VACE path within one A800.
limitations: Successful optimization does not establish that the adapter improves the held-out late window.
The teacher and data are same-scene generated supervision with residual hand smear.
next_actions: Run matched zero-shot and epoch-3 inference on the frame-594 holdout and apply unchanged proxy plus human semantic gates.
